description: The hook `json.dumps` calls for objects it cannot encode; return an encodable value or call `super().default(o)` to raise `TypeError`.
A `json.loads` hook called with the original text of every number that has a fraction or exponent; `Decimal` keeps every digit.
Called with `NaN`, `Infinity` or `-Infinity`, which Python accepts by default although they are not valid JSON.
`sort_keys=True` plus compact `separators` so equal values always produce identical text.
Tuples come back as lists and non-string keys as strings: `loads(dumps(x)) != x`.
Loading a pickle can call any importable function chosen by whoever wrote the bytes; never unpickle untrusted data.
